name: TC Archive Processor
description: Archive compression/decompression for path pipelines. Create, extract, list archives (zip/tar/tar.gz/tar.bz2/tar.xz). Zero external dependencies, stdlib zipfile + tarfile only. Path whitelist + zip bomb defense.
description_zh: 路径管道用压缩归档处理工具。创建、解压、列出归档文件 (zip/tar/tar.gz/tar.bz2/tar.xz)。零外部依赖，纯 stdlib zipfile + tarfile。路径白名单 + zip bomb 防御。

directives.usage_zh: 压缩归档;创建归档,<包路径>,<源路径>[,<格式>]
directives.description: Create a compressed archive from a directory or file. Format auto-detected from extension (zip/tar/tar.gz/tar.bz2/tar.xz) or specified explicitly.
directives.description_zh: 从目录或文件创建压缩归档。格式从扩展名自动推断 (zip/tar/tar.gz/tar.bz2/tar.xz)，也可手动指定。

params_desc.source_path: Source directory or file to archive
params_desc.format: Archive format: zip (default), tar, tar.gz, tar.bz2, tar.xz. Auto-detected from archive_path extension if omitted.

directives.usage_zh: 压缩归档;解压归档,<包路径>,<目标目录>
directives.description: Extract an archive to a destination directory. Defends against zip bombs and path traversal attacks.
directives.description_zh: 将归档解压到目标目录。防御 zip bomb 和路径穿越攻击。

directives.usage_zh: 压缩归档;列出内容,<包路径>
directives.description: List the contents of an archive without extracting. Shows file names, sizes, and types.
directives.description_zh: 列出归档内容而不解压。显示文件名、大小和类型。
